toast.started: Session started — armed tables are now recording
toast.assembling: Table {number}: assembling the audio that reached the server
toast.releasedAssembling: Table {number} released — its recording so far is being transcribed
toast.releasedEmpty: Table {number} released — it had not uploaded any audio yet

reasons.NO_RECORDER: no phone has joined — show the table its QR code
reasons.MIC_UNAVAILABLE: microphone not capturing — tap the phone to allow it
reasons.LOW_STORAGE: storage low — swap or free the phone after this session
reasons.LOW_BATTERY: battery low — ask the table for a backup phone
reasons.UPLOAD_STALLED: upload backlog — check the venue Wi-Fi
reasons.LIVE_STT_UNAVAILABLE: live captions off at this table
reasons.PARTICIPANT_CONSENT_MISSING: nobody at the table has consented yet — register a participant on the table phone

health.attention: {count} table needs attention{blocked}. | {count} tables need attention{blocked}.
health.quietFolded: {count} table is fine and folded below. | {count} tables are fine and folded below.

prior.silent: earlier part — the phone went silent
prior.handedOver: earlier part — the phone was handed over

nextStep.autoStart: Armed tables will start recording Session {position} automatically.
nextStep.allDoneHint: Review the findings in the Analysis tab, then publish the report to the table phones from the Report tab.

broadcast.title: Message the tables
broadcast.placeholder: A prompt or an instruction for the tables

ai.title: AI facilitator
ai.nudges: {count} nudge this session | {count} nudges this session

countbar.independent: Independent tables — each table records on its own schedule

handOver.title: Hand this table to another phone?
handOver.message: Table {number}'s phone has stopped responding. Its recording is finished with the audio already received — usually most of the session — and transcribed. The table can then record the rest on any phone by scanning the same QR code.

startUnready.title: Start with tables missing?
startUnready.message: Only {ready} of {total} tables are armed and ready. Tables that arm later can still join the session. Start anyway?

empty.title: This assembly has no sessions yet
empty.hint: Add a session on the Sessions tab to start recording.

quiet.show: {count} table running normally — show | {count} tables running normally — show
quiet.hide: {count} table running normally — hide | {count} tables running normally — hide

actions.retryTranscriptionTitle: Retry transcription (use if it has been stuck)
actions.acknowledgeTitle: The table raised its hand — tell it you have seen it
actions.pauseAiTitle: Pause the AI facilitator at this table
actions.resumeAiTitle: Let the AI facilitator speak at this table again (the assembly's level)
actions.handOverTitle: This table's phone has stopped responding — hand the table to another phone
actions.retryTitle: Assemble and transcribe the audio that reached the server before the phone stopped

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: The transcript is empty (no speech detected).

toast.purgeNone: No table phones have connected to this assembly
toast.purgeAsked: Asked {count} table phone to clear its copy | Asked {count} table phones to clear their copy
toast.retranscribing: Transcribing again from the stored audio — this can take a few minutes
toast.transcriptDeletedRetranscribable: Transcript deleted — this recording can be transcribed again
toast.recordingsCleared: {count} recording cleared — {size} freed | {count} recordings cleared — {size} freed

header.title: Audio files & exports
header.purge: Clear audio from the table phones

coverage.askedOnClose: The phones were asked to clear this assembly's audio when the session was closed.
coverage.reported: recorder sessions last reported no local recordings.
coverage.unknown: {count} have not reported a local recording count.
coverage.note: These counts include older sessions. Joining again can count the same phone more than once; expired or revoked sessions may need manual cleanup.

files.keptPastRetention: {count} recording was kept past the retention period because no transcript exists for it — for it, the audio is the only record of the discussion. Retry transcription, or delete it deliberately. | {count} recordings were kept past the retention period because no transcript exists for them — for those, the audio is the only record of the discussion. Retry transcription, or delete them deliberately.
files.exportHint: The full session export bundles metadata, audio, transcripts and the report — enough to move this assembly to another server. Deleting audio keeps transcripts, findings and the report.

empty.title: No recordings yet
empty.hint: Audio files appear here as soon as the tables record and synchronize.

files.liveTitle: From the live captions, not a transcription of the finished audio

actions.retranscribeTitle: Transcribe again from the stored audio

confirmRetranscribe.title: Transcribe this table again?
confirmRetranscribe.message: Table {number} will be transcribed again from its stored audio{replacing}. Quotes inside existing findings refer to the old text, so they are marked as removed, and the analysis runs again. The audio is not touched.
confirmRetranscribe.replacingLive: , replacing the transcript taken from the live captions

confirmDeleteAudio.title: Delete this table's audio?
confirmDeleteAudio.message: The audio of table {number} will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Its transcript, findings and the report are kept — but the recording can never be transcribed again.

confirmDeleteTranscript.title: Delete this table's transcript?
confirmDeleteTranscript.message: The verbatim text of table {number} will be permanently erased — including the quotes shown inside findings and in the published report. The findings and AI summaries stay. {audioNote}
confirmDeleteTranscript.audioStillHere: The audio is still here, so this recording can be transcribed again.
confirmDeleteTranscript.audioGone: Its audio is already deleted, so the transcript cannot be recreated.

confirmPurge.title: Clear this assembly's audio from the table phones?
confirmPurge.message: Each phone still holds the audio it recorded. This asks them to delete it — but only the parts the server has already confirmed, so nothing can be lost. It reaches phones whose recorder is still open; one that was closed and taken away will clear itself if it is opened again.

confirmAllTranscripts.title: Delete all transcripts of this session?
confirmAllTranscripts.message: Every table's verbatim text will be permanently erased, including the quotes inside findings and in the published report. Findings and AI summaries stay. Tables whose audio is still here can be transcribed again.

confirmAllAudio.title: Delete all audio of this session?
confirmAllAudio.message: {scale} will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Transcripts, findings and the report are kept. Download or export first if you need a copy.
